basedOn: Standard GI physiology: pancreatic bicarbonate neutralization (~pH 6-7), bile-salt emulsification into micelles as the fat-soluble (A/D/E/K) vehicle, and pancreatic amylase/protease/lipase activity (teaching averages).
sources: NIDDK - Your Digestive System & How It Works: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/digestive-system-how-it-works
Hall & Hall, Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. - Unit XII, Gastrointestinal Physiology
Boron & Boulpaep, Medical Physiology, 3rd ed. - The Gastrointestinal System

inputs.description: Fat available to form micelles / carry the fat-soluble path

neutralize.label: Bicarbonate neutralization
neutralize.detail: Pancreatic bicarbonate raises luminal pH from stomach acid to ~6-7 so pancreatic enzymes can work - the wrong pH stalls everything downstream.

emulsify.label: Bile emulsification -> fat droplets
emulsify.detail: Bile salts (with lecithin) emulsify triglyceride into fine droplets - this is what exposes surface area for pancreatic lipase + colipase. Mixed micelles form later, from the products of lipolysis (see the enzyme step), not here.

edgeCases.effect: Little dietary fat -> little emulsification and few mixed micelles downstream -> the fat-soluble (A/D/E/K) absorption path may under-fire (fat-vehicle gate, L-FAT-1 concept).
edgeCases.note: Teaching flag only, not a score.

edgeCases.effect: Reduced bile -> poor emulsification -> fat + fat-soluble vitamin malabsorption; steatorrhea teaching pattern.
edgeCases.note: Cholestasis / cholecystectomy context. Teaching flag only.

enzymeAttack.label: Pancreatic enzymes -> lipolysis -> mixed micelles
enzymeAttack.detail: CCK (triggered by dietary fat/protein) drives pancreatic enzyme + gallbladder/bile release; secretin drives the bicarbonate. Brush-border enteropeptidase activates trypsinogen -> trypsin, which then activates the other proteases (chymotrypsin, elastase, carboxypeptidases). Pancreatic lipase, with colipase, hydrolyzes triglyceride to free fatty acids + 2-monoacylglycerol; those lipolytic products, with bile salts, assemble into mixed micelles (~4-7 nm) that ferry lipid and the fat-soluble vitamins (A/D/E/K) to the brush border. Amylase continues starch -> maltose.

handoff.label: Chyme -> jejunum
handoff.detail: Neutralized, emulsified, enzyme-primed chyme reaches the main absorption window.
